contentPattern: One row per tile. Cell 1: icon image. Cell 2: rich text - short title (optional extra text). Cell 3 (optional): link making the whole tile clickable. Icon renders at the top, title pinned to the bottom of a tall tile.
usage: Four-column grid of tall tiles with a small line icon at the top and a short title at the bottom (plan features, security solutions).
reuseGuidance: Use for compact icon + title feature grids without descriptions. Option light is a color scheme. For cards with heading + description use cards-feature.
